```artifact
Feature: Patient History File and System Performance

  Scenario Outline: Retrieve patient history for the last 3 years
    Given a patient with ID <patient_id>
    When the system retrieves the patient's history
    Then the system should return the history within 4 seconds
    And the history should include consultations from the last 3 years

    Examples:
      | patient_id |
      | P001       |
      | P002       |
      | P003       |

  Scenario Outline: System should scale to 10,000+ users concurrently
    Given the system is under load with <user_count> concurrent users
    When the system handles the load
    Then the system should handle the load without performance degradation

    Examples:
      | user_count |
      | 1000       |
      | 5000       |
      | 10000      |

  Scenario Outline: Patient Registration should be <= 4 seconds
    Given a new patient with ID <patient_id>
    When the system registers the patient
    Then the registration should complete within 4 seconds

    Examples:
      | patient_id |
      | P001       |
      | P002       |
      | P003       |

  Scenario Outline: Patient Consultation Requests should be <= 2 seconds
    Given a patient with ID <patient_id>
    When the system receives a consultation request
    Then the request should be processed within 2 seconds

    Examples:
      | patient_id |
      | P001       |
      | P002       |
      | P003       |

  Scenario Outline: Chemist - Prescription Requests should be <= 2 seconds
    Given a patient with ID <patient_id>
    When the system receives a prescription request
    Then the request should be processed within 2 seconds

    Examples:
      | patient_id |
      | P001       |
      | P002       |
      | P003       |

  Scenario Outline: Labs - Lab Requests should be <= 4 seconds
    Given a patient with ID <patient_id>
    When the system receives a lab request
    Then the request should be processed within 4 seconds

    Examples:
      | patient_id |
      | P001       |
      | P002       |
      | P003       |

  Scenario Outline: Patient - Prescription & Invoice Look-up should be <= 4 seconds
    Given a patient with ID <patient_id>
    When the system receives a request for prescription and invoice look-up
    Then the request should be processed within 4 seconds

    Examples:
      | patient_id |
      | P001       |
      | P002       |
      | P003       |

  Scenario Outline: Negative test case for patient history retrieval
    Given a non-existent patient with ID <patient_id>
    When the system retrieves the patient's history
    Then the system should return a 404 error

    Examples:
      | patient_id |
      | N001       |
      | N002       |
      | N003       |

  Scenario Outline: Negative test case for patient registration
    Given a patient with an invalid ID <patient_id>
    When the system registers the patient
    Then the registration should fail with a 400 error

    Examples:
      | patient_id |
      | INV001     |
      | INV002     |
      | INV003     |

  Scenario Outline: Negative test case for patient consultation request
    Given a patient with an invalid ID <patient_id>
    When the system receives a consultation request
    Then the request should fail with a 400 error

    Examples:
      | patient_id |
      | INV001     |
      | INV002     |
      | INV003     |

  Scenario Outline: Negative test case for chemist prescription request
    Given a patient with an invalid ID <patient_id>
    When the system receives a prescription request
    Then the request should fail with a 400 error

    Examples:
      | patient_id |
      | INV001     |
      | INV002     |
      | INV003     |

  Scenario Outline: Negative test case for labs lab request
    Given a patient with an invalid ID <patient_id>
    When the system receives a lab request
    Then the request should fail with a 400 error

    Examples:
      | patient_id |
      | INV001     |
      | INV002     |
      | INV003     |

  Scenario Outline: Negative test case for patient prescription & invoice look-up
    Given a patient with an invalid ID <patient_id>
    When the system receives a request for prescription and invoice look-up
    Then the request should fail with a 400 error

    Examples:
      | patient_id |
      | INV001     |
      | INV002     |
      | INV003     |
```
